claim.statement: For all $R, dR, c, s, dS \in \mathbb{Z}$: \[ (dR \cdot s + R \cdot c \cdot dS)(R \cdot c) - (dR \cdot c - R \cdot s \cdot dS)(R \cdot s) = dS \cdot \bigl((R \cdot c)^2 + (R \cdot s)^2\bigr). \]

mismatches.detail: Title “\texttt{Bohm.guidance\_cleared}” shares almost no terms with the statement.
mismatches.question: Paper claim Theorem 1 (theorem-1) states: “For all $R, dR, c, s, dS \in \mathbb{Z}$: \[ (dR \cdot s + R \cdot c \cdot dS)(R \cdot c) - (dR \cdot c - R \cdot s \cdot dS)(R \cdot s) = dS \cdot \bigl((R \cdot c)^2 + (R \cdot s)^2\bigr). \]”. clarification.question: Paper claim Theorem 1 (theorem-1) states: “For all $R, dR, c, s, dS \in \mathbb{Z}$: \[ (dR \cdot s + R \cdot c \cdot dS)(R \cdot c) - (dR \cdot c - R \cdot s \cdot dS)(R \cdot s) = dS \cdot \bigl((R \cdot c)^2 + (R \cdot s)^2\bigr). \]”.
